questions.question: Clarify the exact scope of the solution to Hilbert’s fourth problem: the author’s statement about all realizations of the axiom systems of classical geometries may be too broad.

localizations.source: Clarify the exact scope of the solution to Hilbert’s fourth problem: the author’s statement about all realizations of the axiom systems of classical geometries may be too broad.
localizations.ru: Уточнить точный объём решения IV проблемы Гильберта: авторская формулировка о «всех реализациях систем аксиом классических геометрий» может быть чрезмерно широкой.

questions.resolution: The absolute claim about all realizations of classical axiom systems was replaced with the verifiable statement about a broad class of metrics whose geodesics are straight lines.

questions.question: Review the author’s critique of the textbook, especially the priority claim about rigorous axioms; the author’s assessment is preserved in the transfer.

localizations.source: Review the author’s critique of the textbook, especially the priority claim about rigorous axioms; the author’s assessment is preserved in the transfer.
localizations.ru: Согласовать авторский критический разбор учебника и особенно утверждение «впервые» о строгой аксиоматике; оценка не заменена нейтральным пересказом при переносе.

questions.resolution: The unsupported priority claim and personal judgement were removed. The author’s substantive assessment remains: rigorous axioms, demanding problems and the need for methodological adaptation.
